easy.def: A story people tell that may not be true.
examples: I heard a rumor that we will get a new slide.

more.def: A story that is passed from person to person and may or may not be true.
examples: There was a rumor that school would close early.
A rumor spread that a famous singer was in town.
Do not believe every rumor you hear.

easy.def: To move fast on your legs.
examples: Do not run in the hall.

more.def: To move quickly on foot, faster than walking.
examples: The children ran across the field to catch the kite.
Cheetahs run faster than any other animal.
He runs around the track every morning.

easy.def: To work the way it needs to.

more.def: To work or operate, or to flow.
examples: The toy train runs on batteries.
A small stream runs through the meadow.
Do not let the water run while you brush your teeth.
